summary: Backend-only testing for TK SafetyGuard. Built pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/) hitting the external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Covered auth (register/login/me/wrong-pw/401 protection on 6 endpoints), dashboard shape, LOTO create+list+release+404, site access signin/signout/visitor with on_site counting, traffic zones, incidents create+list+close, AI machinery assessment with a realistic PIL-generated warehouse JPEG (forklift, racks, worker, exit sign), and assessment persistence via GET. Result: 21/21 tests passed. AI /api/ai/assess with Gemini 3.1 Pro returned a valid structured JSON (overall_risk_level, hazards[], summary) in ~27s and stored the photo. No backend issues detected.

minor.issue: Does not return 404 when the incident id does not exist; always returns a body (null after find_one). Minor - main agent may want to add existence check.
Accepts arbitrary 'status' query values (no enum validation).
Soft-delete does not verify the record exists before responding {ok: true}.

action_items: (Optional) Add 404 handling in PATCH /api/incidents/{iid} when the incident is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 520-line file; still acceptable but consider splitting routes/models as features grow.
AccessIn does not validate type enum; string is accepted as-is. Not blocking but should be Literal['signin','signout','visitor'].
TrafficIn.zone_type is not enum-validated either (should be Literal).
get_object uses 60s timeout via requests inside a threadpool - fine for the current scale.
Auth-protected routes correctly return 401 when no Authorization header is present (verified in tests).
seed_data_creation: Test user safety@tk.com/test1234 already existed; tests handle both first-run register and existing-user login. Test rows are prefixed with TEST_ for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. AI assessment uses gemini-3.1-pro-preview via emergentintegrations and returns structured JSON per prompt schema. Test warehouse image is generated in conftest.py with PIL (Pillow is installed). If frontend testing is requested next, focus on Expo web preview at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, verify mobile viewport 375x667, test capture + gallery flows and AI result rendering. All backend routes are under /api prefix and require Bearer JWT.
